observation.command:
cd /workspace
git rev-list --all --objects | grep -i -E "UserMenuContent|UserInfo" | head
echo "=== all objects count ==="
git rev-list --all --objects | wc -l
echo "=== tags ==="
git tag
echo "=== search each tag ==="
for t in $(git tag); do echo "--- $t ---"; git ls-tree -r $t --name-only | grep -i -E "UserMenuContent|UserInfo"; done
